name: Monorepo Architect Task
description: Common configuration for analyzing, managing, and orchestrating the Aphrody pentalingual monorepo (Bun, Cargo, MSVC, Turbo).

rules.ts_layer: Use Bun Workspaces for all JS/TS dependencies. Strictly enforce bun.lockb.
rules.rust_layer: Use Cargo Workspaces. Share dependencies via workspace.dependencies.
rules.cpp_layer: Use CMake with add_subdirectory. Compile natively.
rules.orchestration: Use Turborepo (turbo.json) for cross-language dependency graphs and task caching.
